Ann Radcliffe, A Sicilian Romance.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ann-radcliffe/a-sicilian-romance

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ann Radcliffe, the author, died 1823 (citizenship: Kingdom of Great Britain, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1790 (SE colophon: 'A Sicilian Romance was published in 1790 by Ann Radcliffe.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1790, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1885.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts): the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1823.
